title: github fetch_copilot_usage
description: One day of Copilot metrics, passed through unchanged from the GitHub REST API. snake_case keys. Two record kinds share the operation, told apart by metadata type: org_metrics is one element of GET /orgs/{org}/copilot/metrics, and user_metrics is one element of GET /orgs/{org}/copilot/usage/user. GitHub can add keys to both.

github_com_user_id.description: A numeric user id, as a string or a JSON number; both are passed through. An element without one is skipped.
